name: deck-design
description: Build slide decks that survive critic review. Bundles two skills: deck-mindset (5-color vocabulary on dark backgrounds + 15pt floor + 3-tier hierarchy + 5 named layouts + 8 card families) and deck-agent-team (Phase-2 review via parallel critic agents — visual + content + cognitive + compliance — with PASS/FAIL gate and human-checked patch apply). Use when designing or auditing presentations that prioritize consistency and audience cognition over visual variety.
